summary: Agent organization of 16 departments and 172 skills, each installable on its own in Claude Code and ChatGPT.
description: An agent organization structured as a company: a chief executive over 16 departments (technology, security, IT operations, product, finance …) with 172 skills in total. Every department is an independently installable plugin, so a project loads only what it needs; skills load themselves when a request matches and are addressed as department:skill.
contains: departments incl. technology (19 skills), security (8, reviewer-class), IT operations (12), product (11)
each department installs independently as a plugin
same repo serves Claude Code and ChatGPT/Codex
skills addressed as department:skill, e.g. security:threat-modeling
